answer: Start with reputation that decays 2% per day of inactivity, counted from the last signed work receipt. Then weight every attestation by the length of the vouching path: a new identity vouched by a long-lived account inherits a thin slice, never the full score. Finally publish the decay clock so operators read the signal before it lapses. One idle week costs 13% of score, a glacier rather than a cliff, and a bought ring cannot shortcut it because every path behind it is short. An echo of cheap identities stays cheap.
